---
title: "NFU Summary Dashboard"
format:
  dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    theme: minty
    nav-buttons:
      - text: "Vanessa Mora"
        href: "mailto:VanessaMora@Wildlife.ca.gov"
        icon: person-circle
server: shiny
include-in-header:
  text: |
    <script>
    (function() {
      function reportActiveTab() {
        var activeLink = document.querySelector('.navbar-nav .nav-link.active');
        if (activeLink) {
          var textSpan = activeLink.querySelector('.nav-link-text');
          var tabName = (textSpan ? textSpan.textContent : activeLink.textContent)
            .replace(/[\n\r]+|[\s]{2,}/g, ' ').trim();
          if (window.Shiny && Shiny.setInputValue) {
            Shiny.setInputValue('active_tab', tabName);
          }
        }
      }

      function init() {
        reportActiveTab();
        var nav = document.querySelector('.navbar-nav');
        if (nav) {
          var observer = new MutationObserver(function() { reportActiveTab(); });
          observer.observe(nav, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'], subtree: true });
        }
      }

      if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
      } else {
        init();
      }
    })();
    </script>

```{r}
#| context: setup
# Load the  data
all_data <- read_csv("Smelt_Dashboard_Data.csv") 

# Combine and Clean
month_order <- c("Dec", "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug")
station_order <- c("340", "342", "343", "344", "345", "346", "347", "348", "349")

water_year <- data.frame(
  wy = c(1995:2026),
  yearType = c("W","W","W","W","W","AN","D","D","AN","BN","AN","W","D","C","D", "BN", "W", "BN", "D", "C", "C", "BN", "W", "BN","W", "D", "C", "C", "W", "AN", "AN", "AN")  
)

all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    wy = as.integer(wy),
    month = factor(month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE), levels = month_order),
    survey_label = paste(source, survey),
    station = as.character(station),
    count = as.integer(station_total_count),
    cpue = station_cpue,
    length = as.integer(length),
    numTows = as.integer(numTows),
    survey = as.integer(survey)
  ) %>%
  mutate(survey_label = fct_reorder(survey_label, date, .fun = min)) %>%
  left_join(water_year, by = "wy")


# 1. Define Region Order and Colors
region_order <- c(
  "Central & South Delta", 
  "Sacramento River System", 
  "Confluence",
  "Suisun Bay & Marsh",
  "Napa River",
  "San Pablo & Carquinez Strait"
)

region_colors <- c(
  "San Pablo & Carquinez Strait"        = "#80b1d3", 
  "Napa River"                          = "#bebada", 
  "Suisun Bay & Marsh"                  = "#fdb462", 
  "Confluence"                          = "#ffffb3", 
  "Sacramento River System"             = "#fb8072", 
  "Central & South Delta"               = "#8dd3c7"
)

# --- WATER QUALITY PARAMETER CHOICES ---
wq_param_choices <- c(
  "Secchi Depth (m)"          = "secchi",
  "Surface Temperature (°C)"  = "tempSurf",
  "Surface Salinity (ppt)"    = "salSurf",
  "Bottom Salinity (ppt)"     = "salBot",
  "Turbidity (FNU)"           = "fnu",
  "Turbidity (NTU)"           = "ntu"
)

```

```{r}
#| context: server

# Show the disclaimer immediately on startup
observe({
  showModal(modalDialog(
    title = "Beta Version Notice",
    "Welcome to the NFU Summary Dashboard! Please note that this application is currently in beta mode.",
    tags$br(), tags$br(),
    "Features and data are preliminary/subject to change as I continue development.",
    footer = modalButton("I Understand"),
    size = "m",
    easyClose = FALSE
  ))
})

# This ensures SLS 12/13 (December) come before SLS 1 (January)
sls_custom_order <- c("SLS 12", "SLS 13", "SLS 1", "SLS 2", "SLS 3", "SLS 4", "SLS 5", "SLS 6")


output$dynamic_sidebar <- renderUI({
  is_map_tab <- "Longfin Smelt Distribution" %in% input$active_tab
  is_wq_tab  <- "Water Quality" %in% input$active_tab
  
  if (is_map_tab) {
    tagList(
      hr(),
      tags$strong("Map Snapshot"),
      uiOutput("map_controls") 
    )
  } else if (is_wq_tab) {
    tagList(
      hr(),
      selectizeInput("regions", "Select Region(s):", 
                     choices = c("ALL", region_order),
                     selected = "Napa River", multiple = TRUE,
                     options = list(plugins = list("remove_button"))),
      hr(),
      checkboxGroupInput("source", "Project:", choices = c("20mm", "SLS"), 
                         selected = c("20mm", "SLS"), inline = TRUE),
      hr(),
      selectInput("wq_param", "Select Water Quality Parameter:", 
                  choices = wq_param_choices)
    )
  } else {
    tagList(
      hr(),
      selectizeInput("regions", "Select Region(s):", 
                     choices = c("ALL", region_order),
                     selected = "Napa River", multiple = TRUE,
                     options = list(plugins = list("remove_button"))),
      hr(),
      checkboxGroupInput("source", "Project:", choices = c("20mm", "SLS"), 
                         selected = c("20mm", "SLS"), inline = TRUE)
    )
  }
})

# --- MAP SNAPSHOT DROPDOWN ---
output$map_controls <- renderUI({
  req(input$years)
  if ("ALL" %in% input$years) return(helpText("Select specific years to view maps."))
  
  mm_levels  <- paste("20mm", 1:9)
  all_levels <- c(sls_custom_order, mm_levels)
  
  raw_choices <- all_data %>% 
    filter(wy %in% input$years) %>% 
    pull(survey_label) %>% 
    unique()
  
  choices <- intersect(all_levels, raw_choices)
    
  selectInput("current_map_survey", "Select Survey for Map:", choices = choices)
})


# --- 4. REACTIVE DATASET (Updated for Regions) ---
all_r <- reactive({
  req(input$years) # We always need years
  
  # IF ON THE MAP TAB: Skip the region/source/survey requirements
  if ("Longfin Smelt Distribution" %in% input$active_tab) {
    df <- all_data
    if (!"ALL" %in% input$years) df <- df %>% filter(wy %in% input$years)
    return(df)
  }
  
  # IF ON OTHER TABS: Require everything
  req(input$regions, input$source)
  df <- all_data
  
  if (!"ALL" %in% input$years) df <- df %>% filter(wy %in% input$years)
  if (!"ALL" %in% input$regions) df <- df %>% filter(oldregionupdate %in% input$regions)
  
  df <- df %>% filter(source %in% input$source)

  
  return(df)
})

# --- LENGTH DATA (expanded to one row per fish, filtered to measured fish only) ---
length_r <- reactive({
  df <- all_r() %>% 
    filter(!is.na(length), !is.na(total_len_freq), total_len_freq > 0) %>%
    mutate(total_len_freq = as.integer(round(total_len_freq))) %>%
    tidyr::uncount(total_len_freq) %>%   # one row per actual fish
    group_by(survey_label) %>%
    mutate(month = factor(month(min(date), label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE), levels = month_order))%>%
    ungroup()
  df$survey_label <- fct_drop(df$survey_label)
  df
})

# --- 5. VALUE BOXES ---

# Fix 1: Total Tows (Summing physical tows, ignoring length rows)
output$stat_tows <- renderUI({
  data <- all_r()
  if(nrow(data) == 0) return(value_box("Total Tows", 0, theme = "primary"))
  
  # We look at unique station visits and sum the 'numTows' column (1, 2, or 3)
  effort_summary <- data %>% 
    distinct(source, wy, survey, station, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  total <- sum(effort_summary$numTows, na.rm = TRUE)
  sls_val <- sum(effort_summary$numTows[effort_summary$source == "SLS"], na.rm = TRUE)
  mm_val  <- sum(effort_summary$numTows[effort_summary$source == "20mm"], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  value_box(
    title = div("Total Tows", style = "text-align: center;"),
    value = div(format(round(total), big.mark = ","), style = "text-align: center;"),
    p(paste0("SLS: ", format(round(sls_val), big.mark = ","), " | 20mm: ", format(round(mm_val), big.mark = ",")), 
      style = "text-align: center; font-size: 0.9em;"),
    theme = "primary"
  )
})

# Fix 2: Total Surveys (Counting unique survey events)
output$stat_surveys <- renderUI({
  data <- all_r()
  if(nrow(data) == 0) return(value_box("Total Surveys", 0, theme = "secondary"))
  
  # A survey is a unique combination of Water Year, Project (Source), and Survey Number
  total <- data %>% select(wy, source, survey) %>% n_distinct()
  
  sls_val <- data %>% filter(source == "SLS") %>% select(wy, survey) %>% n_distinct()
  mm_val  <- data %>% filter(source == "20mm") %>% select(wy, survey) %>% n_distinct()
  
  value_box(
    title = div("Total Surveys", style = "text-align: center;"),
    value = div(total, style = "text-align: center;"),
    p(paste0("SLS: ", sls_val, " | 20mm: ", mm_val), 
      style = "text-align: center; font-size: 0.9em; opacity: 0.9;"),
    theme = "secondary"
  )
})

# Fix 3: Total Fish (Summing the length frequency column to avoid overcounting)
output$stat_fish <- renderUI({
  data <- all_r()
  if(nrow(data) == 0) return(value_box("Total Longfin Smelt", 0, theme = "info"))
  
  # IMPORTANT: We sum 'total_len_freq' because it is NOT repeated per station.
  # If we summed 'count', we would multiply the catch by the number of lengths.
  total <- sum(data$total_len_freq, na.rm = TRUE)
  sls_val <- sum(data$total_len_freq[data$source == "SLS"], na.rm = TRUE)
  mm_val  <- sum(data$total_len_freq[data$source == "20mm"], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  value_box(
    title = div("Total Longfin Smelt", style = "text-align: center;"),
    value = div(format(round(total), big.mark = ","), style = "text-align: center;"),
    p(paste0("SLS: ", format(round(sls_val), big.mark = ","), " | 20mm: ", format(round(mm_val), big.mark = ",")), 
      style = "text-align: center; font-size: 0.9em; opacity: 0.9;"),
    theme = "info"
  )
})

output$effort_table <- renderDT({
  df <- all_r()
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(datatable(data.frame(Status = "No Data Selected"), rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = 't')))
  }

  # This ensures we don't overcount tows because of fish lengths.
  effort_df <- df %>%
    distinct(oldregionupdate, station, wy, survey_label, numTows)

  # Check if we are in "Single Year Mode"
  is_single_year <- length(input$years) == 1 && !("ALL" %in% input$years)

  if (is_single_year) {
    # 1. Define the strict biological/survey order
    sls_levels <- c("SLS 12", "SLS 13", "SLS 1", "SLS 2", "SLS 3", "SLS 4", "SLS 5", "SLS 6")
    mm_levels  <- paste("20mm", 1:9) 
    all_levels <- c(sls_levels, mm_levels)
    
    # 2. Process data
    eff_wide <- effort_df %>%
      group_by(oldregionupdate, station, survey_label) %>%
      # Use sum(numTows) to show 3 for 20mm and 1 for SLS
      summarise(Tows = sum(numTows, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
      mutate(Tows = as.character(Tows)) %>% 
      pivot_wider(names_from = survey_label, values_from = Tows, values_fill = "") %>%
      arrange(oldregionupdate, desc(station))
    
    # 3. FORCE COLUMN ORDER
    present_surveys <- all_levels[all_levels %in% names(eff_wide)]
    eff_wide <- eff_wide %>%
      select(station, all_of(present_surveys))
    
    caption_text <- paste("Number of Tows per Survey for Water Year", input$years)

  } else {
    # MULTI YEAR MODE: Show Water Years across the top
    eff_wide <- effort_df %>%
      group_by(oldregionupdate, station, wy) %>%
      # Summing numTows here shows total tows for that whole year
      summarise(Tows = sum(numTows, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
      mutate(Tows = as.character(Tows)) %>% 
      pivot_wider(names_from = wy, values_from = Tows, values_fill = "") %>%
      arrange(oldregionupdate, desc(station)) %>%
      select(-oldregionupdate)
    
    caption_text <- "Total Annual Tows per Station by Water Year"
  }
  
datatable(
    eff_wide, 
    extensions = 'FixedColumns',
    rownames = FALSE, # Moved this outside of options
    options = list(
      dom = 't', 
      paging = FALSE, 
      scrollX = TRUE,            
      scrollY = "50vh", 
      scrollCollapse = TRUE,
      fixedColumns = list(leftColumns = 1), 
      columnDefs = list(
        list(className = 'dt-center', targets = "_all"),
        list(width = '80px', targets = 0) 
      )
    ),
    caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
      style = 'caption-side: top; text-align: center; color: #666; font-weight: bold;',
      caption_text
    )
  )
})

output$catch_plot_faceted <- renderPlotly({
  data <- all_r() 
  if(nrow(data) == 0) return(NULL)

  # 1. Determine if we are in "Single Year Mode" 
  is_single_year <- length(input$years) == 1 && !("ALL" %in% input$years)
  
  # 2. Setup the Plot Data
  if (is_single_year) {
    sls_levels <- c("SLS 12", "SLS 13", "SLS 1", "SLS 2", "SLS 3", "SLS 4", "SLS 5", "SLS 6")
    mm_levels <- paste("20mm", 1:10)
    
    plot_data <- data %>%
      mutate(source = factor(source, levels = c("SLS", "20mm"))) %>%
      mutate(x_axis = factor(survey_label, levels = intersect(c(sls_levels, mm_levels), unique(data$survey_label)))) %>%
      group_by(x_axis, source, oldregionupdate) %>% 
      # CRUCIAL: Sum total_len_freq to avoid overcounting the repeated 'count' column
      summarise(RegionalCatch = sum(total_len_freq, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(oldregionupdate = factor(oldregionupdate, levels = region_order))
    
    x_label <- NULL 
    facet_scales <- "free" 
    
  } else {
    # MULTI-YEAR MODE
    plot_data <- data %>%
      mutate(source = factor(source, levels = c("SLS", "20mm"))) %>%
      mutate(x_axis = factor(wy)) %>% 
      group_by(x_axis, wy, source, oldregionupdate, yearType) %>% 
      # CRUCIAL: Sum total_len_freq here as well
      summarise(RegionalCatch = sum(total_len_freq, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(oldregionupdate = factor(oldregionupdate, levels = region_order))
    
    x_label <- NULL
    facet_scales <- "free_y"
    
    year_totals <- plot_data %>%
      group_by(x_axis, source, yearType) %>% 
      summarise(AnnualTotal = sum(RegionalCatch), .groups = "drop")
  }

  wy_legend_text <- "<b>W:</b> Wet | <b>AN:</b> Above Normal | <b>BN:</b> Below Normal | <b>D:</b> Dry | <b>C:</b> Critical"

  # 3. Build the ggplot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x_axis, y = RegionalCatch)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = oldregionupdate), color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    
    { if(!is_single_year) geom_text(data = year_totals, 
                                    aes(x = x_axis, y = AnnualTotal, label = paste0(yearType, "\n")), 
                                    vjust = 0.2, size = 3, fontface = "bold") } +
    
    facet_wrap(~source, ncol = 1, scales = facet_scales) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = region_colors, name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.45))) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = x_label, y = "Total Catch") +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing = unit(2.5, "lines"), 
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 15)), # Extra space for label
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
  panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)
    )

  # 4. Convert to Plotly with Margin/Standoff Fixes
  ggplotly(p) %>% 
    layout(
      # Increase bottom margin (b) to 150 and left margin (l) to 80
      margin = list(t = 60, b = 150, l = 80), 
      # standoff moves the "Total Catch" label away from the numbers
      yaxis = list(title = list(standoff = 20)),
      yaxis2 = list(title = list(standoff = 20)),
      legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0.5, xanchor = "center", y = -0.35),
      annotations = if(!is_single_year) {
        list(list(
          x = 0.5, y = -0.28, 
          text = wy_legend_text,
          showarrow = FALSE,
          xref = 'paper', yref = 'paper',
          xanchor = 'center', yanchor = 'bottom',
          font = list(size = 11)
        ))
      } else { list() }
    )
})



create_map_obj <- function(df, max_cpue, title, proj_color, map_height = "40vh") {
  leaflet(height = map_height) %>%
    addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldGrayCanvas) %>%
    addPolygons(data = WW_Delta, weight = 0.5, color = "#5dade2", 
                fillColor = "#D4F1F9", fillOpacity = 0.5) %>%
    addCircleMarkers(data = df %>% filter(station_total_count == 0),
                     lng = ~X, lat = ~Y, radius = 2, color = "grey60", weight = 1, fillOpacity = 0.2) %>%
    addCircleMarkers(data = df %>% filter(station_total_count > 0),
                     lng = ~X, lat = ~Y,
                     radius = ~sqrt(station_cpue / max_cpue) * 15 + 2,
                     color = proj_color, fillColor = proj_color, fillOpacity = 0.7, weight = 1,
                     label = ~paste0("Station: ", station, " | CPUE: ", round(station_cpue, 1))) %>%
    addControl(html = paste0("<div style='background:white;padding:3px;border:1px solid grey;'><b>", title, "</b></div>"), 
               position = "topright")
}

# 4. SYNCED MAPS CONTAINER
output$synced_maps_container <- renderUI({
  req(input$current_map_survey, input$years)
  if ("ALL" %in% input$years) return(helpText("Please deselect 'ALL' to compare specific years."))
  
  # Convert years to numbers safely
  years_vec <- sort(as.numeric(input$years))
  validate(need(length(years_vec) <= 2, "Please select 1 or 2 specific years for comparison."))
  
  # Filter map data (Ignoring regions, using the snapshot dropdown)
  map_df <- all_data %>% 
    filter(wy %in% years_vec, survey_label == input$current_map_survey) %>% 
    distinct(wy, station, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
  req(nrow(map_df) > 0)
  
  max_val <- max(map_df$station_cpue, na.rm = TRUE)
  if(is.infinite(max_val) || max_val <= 0) max_val <- 1
  
  # Height: split evenly if stacking 2 maps, otherwise use the full container
  map_height <- if (length(years_vec) == 2) "40vh" else "85vh"
  
  # Build Map 1
  d1 <- map_df %>% filter(wy == years_vec[1])
  c1 <- if(nrow(d1) > 0 && first(d1$source) == "SLS") "#EF819E" else "#597C2B"
  m1 <- create_map_obj(d1, max_val, paste(years_vec[1], input$current_map_survey), c1, map_height)
  
  if(length(years_vec) == 2) {
    # Build Map 2
    d2 <- map_df %>% filter(wy == years_vec[2])
    c2 <- if(nrow(d2) > 0 && first(d2$source) == "SLS") "#EF819E" else "#597C2B"
    m2 <- create_map_obj(d2, max_val, paste(years_vec[2], input$current_map_survey), c2, map_height)
    leafsync::sync(m1, m2, ncol = 1) 
  } else {
    m1
  }
})


# ---  ---
observeEvent(input$years, {
  yrs <- input$years
  is_length_tab <- "Longfin Smelt Length Frequency" %in% input$active_tab
  
  if (is_length_tab) {
    # Keep the logic that removes "ALL"
    yrs <- yrs[yrs != "ALL"]
    
    # REMOVED the "tail(yrs, 2)" line so the user can select 3+ years
    
    if (!identical(yrs, input$years)) {
      updateSelectizeInput(session, "years", selected = yrs)
    }
  } else {
    if (length(yrs) > 1 && "ALL" %in% yrs) {
      updateSelectizeInput(session, "years", selected = "ALL")
    }
  }
}, ignoreNULL = FALSE)



output$length_boxplot_ui <- renderUI({
  # Handle "ALL" case
  if ("ALL" %in% input$years) {
    return(
      div(style = "margin-top: 100px; text-align: center;",
          h4("Please deselect 'ALL' to compare specific years.")
      )
    )
  }
  
  # Handle more than 2 years or 0 years
  if (is.null(input$years) || length(input$years) == 0 || length(input$years) > 2) {
    return(
      div(style = "margin-top: 1px; text-align: center;",
          h4("Please select 1 or 2 specific years for comparison.")
      )
    )
  }
  
  # If validation passes, show the plot output container
  plotOutput("length_boxplot", height = "750px")
})

# 2. THE ARTIST: Draws the actual plot
output$length_boxplot <- renderPlot({
  # Get the reactive data
  df <- length_r()
  
  # Safety check: If data is empty, show a blank plot with a message
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot() + 
        annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "No Data Available for Selection", size = 6) + 
        theme_void()
    )
  }
  
  # Force correct biological/seasonal order
  mm_levels <- paste("20mm", 1:9)
  all_levels <- c(sls_custom_order, mm_levels)
  df$survey_label <- factor(as.character(df$survey_label), 
                            levels = intersect(all_levels, unique(as.character(df$survey_label))))
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      source = factor(source, levels = c("SLS", "20mm")),
      wy = factor(wy)
    )
  
  is_all_regions <- "ALL" %in% input$regions
  multi_region <- !is_all_regions && n_distinct(df$oldregionupdate) > 1
  multi_year   <- n_distinct(df$wy) > 1
  
  row_vars <- if (multi_region) "oldregionupdate" else "."
  facet_formula <- as.formula(paste(row_vars, "~ month"))
  
  years_present <- sort(unique(as.character(df$wy)))
  year_text   <- paste(years_present, collapse = " vs ")
  region_text <- if (is_all_regions) "All Regions (Combined)" else paste(unique(df$oldregionupdate), collapse = " vs ")
  
  y_upper <- 50
  
  # Setup colors
  if (multi_year) {
    fill_var <- "wy"
    fill_colors <- c("#4A7FB5", "#D9822B")
    names(fill_colors) <- years_present
    legend_title <- "Water Year"
  } else {
    fill_var <- "source"
    fill_colors <- c("SLS" = "#EF819E", "20mm" = "#597C2B")
    legend_title <- "Gear Type"
  }
  
  # Build Plot
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = survey_label, y = length, fill = .data[[fill_var]]))
  
  if (multi_year) {
    p <- p +
      geom_jitter(aes(color = .data[[fill_var]]), 
                  position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.5, jitter.height = 0.6, dodge.width = 0.7),
                  alpha = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, 
                   position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6)
  } else {
    p <- p +
      geom_jitter(aes(color = .data[[fill_var]]), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6)
  }
  
  p +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, y_upper, by = 5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_upper)) +
    facet_grid(facet_formula, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x", switch = "x") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = fill_colors) +
    labs(
      x = NULL, y = "Fork Length (mm)",
      title = "Longfin Smelt Growth by Gear Type",
      subtitle = paste0(region_text, " | ", year_text),
      fill = legend_title
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 20),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.placement = "outside",
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
})

# --- WATER QUALITY DATA (deduped to one row per station visit) ---
wq_r <- reactive({
  df <- all_r()
  req(df)
  req(input$wq_param)
  
  # Remove fish-level duplication - keep one row per station visit
  df <- df %>%
    distinct(oldregionupdate, wy, survey_label, source, station, 
             secchi, tempSurf, salSurf, salBot, fnu, ntu)
  
  is_all_regions <- "ALL" %in% input$regions
  multi_region <- !is_all_regions && n_distinct(df$oldregionupdate) > 1
  
  group_vars <- c("wy", "survey_label", "source")
if (!is_all_regions) group_vars <- c("oldregionupdate", group_vars)
  
  df %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) %>%
    summarise(value = mean(.data[[input$wq_param]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(value = ifelse(is.nan(value), NA, value))
})

output$water_quality_plot <- renderPlot({
  df <- wq_r()
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0 || all(is.na(df$value))) {
    return(
      ggplot() + 
        annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "No Data Selected", size = 6) + 
        theme_void()
    )
  }
  
  mm_levels <- paste("20mm", 1:9)
  all_levels <- c(sls_custom_order, mm_levels)
  df$survey_label <- factor(as.character(df$survey_label), 
                            levels = intersect(all_levels, unique(as.character(df$survey_label))))
  
  df <- df %>% mutate(wy = factor(wy))
  
  multi_year   <- n_distinct(df$wy) > 1
  is_all_regions <- "ALL" %in% input$regions
  multi_region <- !is_all_regions && "oldregionupdate" %in% names(df) && n_distinct(df$oldregionupdate) > 1
  
  years_present <- sort(unique(as.character(df$wy)))
  year_text   <- paste(years_present, collapse = " vs ")
  region_text <- if (is_all_regions) "All Regions (Combined)" else paste(unique(input$regions), collapse = " vs ")
  param_label <- names(wq_param_choices)[wq_param_choices == input$wq_param]
  
  if (multi_year) {
  n_yrs <- length(years_present)
  year_colors <- if (n_yrs <= 2) {
    setNames(c("#4A7FB5", "#D9822B")[1:n_yrs], years_present)
  } else {
    setNames(scales::hue_pal()(n_yrs), years_present)
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = survey_label, y = value, group = wy, color = wy)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = year_colors) +
    labs(color = "Water Year")
  
} else {
  # Single year: color by region, shape by source, all on one panel
  df <- df %>% mutate(source = factor(source, levels = c("SLS", "20mm")))
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = survey_label, y = value, 
                       group = interaction(oldregionupdate, source), 
                       color = oldregionupdate, shape = source)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = region_colors) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("SLS" = 16, "20mm" = 17)) +
    labs(color = "Region", shape = "Gear Type")
}
  
  p <- p +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = param_label,
      title = param_label,
      subtitle = paste0(region_text, " | ", year_text)
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 20, margin = margin(b = 5)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, margin = margin(b = 15)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black", margin = margin(r = 10)),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black", face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12, color = "black"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
  
  if (multi_year && multi_region) {
  p <- p + facet_grid(oldregionupdate ~ ., scales = "fixed")
}

  p
})
```
